findings.summary: The author's discrete SUM(2021 Sales) pill is stored as <column-instance derivation='Sum' name='[sum:...:ok]' type='ordinal'>. The field registry derives Sum instances only with the ':qk' suffix and ordinal declarations only with derivation='None', so that exact Sum+ordinal pair cannot be requested through the public API.
findings.workaround: Declare a second calculated field SUM([2021 Sales]) with role=measure, field_type='ordinal'; the registry then emits [usr:...:ok], the ordinal-aggregate form the author corpus also uses (22 instances across dashboards/).
findings.note: No SDK change is required for this case; recorded as a builder workaround only.

findings.summary: The author's published raster prints each % Difference label one row below its mark from the second row onwards, while the author's workbook XML attaches the text encoding with no per-row offset.
findings.workaround: The verifier pins the extract to the printed 2021 pill values and the 2020 dot positions (recovered through a fitted pixel scale) and checks the published label sequence with the documented one-row shift.
